description: Search Iași Airport arrivals and departures by date, city (also matches an airline name or IATA code), airport code, flight number, status, or aircraft type (ICAO designator, substring match — AT7 matches the ATR 72 family). `data.truncated` says when the list was cut and `data.matched` counts every match — raise `limit` to list them all. A flight number with no leg on a `date` the board covers returns its nearest leg instead, dated by `fallbackDate`. Aircraft type and registration are known only for flights the tracker has already resolved; scheduled flights carry null. `estimatedArrivalUtc` is a forecast touchdown read while an arrival is airborne, roughly 45 minutes before its scheduled time, and re-read only if the flight is still airborne once that estimate has passed — not an airport-confirmed time. A delay that develops after the latest reading surfaces only once the estimate expires, and an absent field is not a promise of punctuality. iasi.io itself reports it only while it runs 15+ minutes past schedule and still lies in the future, so treat a smaller gap as noise rather than a delay and an estimate already in the past as expired.

status.description: SCHEDULED, EN_ROUTE, DEPARTED, LANDED, CANCELLED, or DIVERTED (case-insensitive). There is no delayed status.

name: search_flights
